Deterministic SQLite final-state and audit-log checks score the batch.

How to run it

1. From the cardcopied from the publisher's own instructions

python3 scripts/run_reference_and_tests.py

2. Get the filesthe whole repository, to a local folder

hf download Maydanlabs/maydan-hf-rl-sampler --repo-type dataset --local-dir maydan-hf-rl-sampler

3. Check it with Harborcommon pattern, not from this card

# the oracle agent runs the reference solution, so no model is called
harbor run --repo https://huggingface.co/datasets/Maydanlabs/maydan-hf-rl-sampler --agent oracle

If every task passes, the environment works on your machine. Then swap in your own agent and model. Some repositories keep the tasks in a subfolder; the card says where.

Framework documentation: Harbor. Needs: Local Python and SQLite for the quickstart; Docker for Harbor.

Evidence

Oracle reached reward 1.0 on all ten tasks with Harbor 0.24.0; negative tests were run.

As reported by the publisher. We have not reproduced it.
